Other candidates were unrelated pages or topical false positives, so no readable exact-work primary artifact was recovered.

No document map was generated because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML primary source was recovered. Per the source adequacy rule, no questions were extracted from zbMATH metadata, local shard metadata, ResearchGate profile metadata, search snippets, or unrelated pages.

The source-adequacy, evidence-coverage, and evidence-completeness gates forbid accepting questions without verbatim evidence from a readable primary source. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
